---

This build is ad-hoc signed and is not notarized. On first launch, approve it under System Settings > Privacy & Security, then enable the per-user background runner in the dashboard and enable the Finder extension. Protected locations may require Full Disk Access for the embedded Finder extension, and macOS may request privacy permissions again after an update.

Install or update: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brohd11/macos-finder-actions/main/install.sh | sh`
